sql_template: SELECT custom_id FROM Messages WHERE feed = :feed AND %1;
source_expression:
QSL("SELECT custom_id "
                "FROM Messages "
                "WHERE feed = :feed AND %1;")
              .arg(query)
dynamic_details: bag enum gives is_read = 0 (Unread), is_important = 1 (Starred), is_read = 1 (Read/default). :feed = feed->id(). No deleted/pdeleted predicates and no LIMIT.

sql_template: SELECT requested.message_index, Messages.id, Messages.date_created, Messages.is_read, Messages.is_important, {contents_column}, Messages.feed, Messages.title, Messages.author FROM ({requested_rows}) AS requested JOIN Messages ON Messages.id = (  SELECT candidate.id FROM Messages AS candidate WHERE candidate.id = requested.lookup_id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY requested.message_index;
source_expression: lookup_query(requested_rows, QSL("candidate.id = requested.lookup_id"))
dynamic_details: See generator_details. force_insert skips lookups; updates reexecute one prepared statement per changed row. Insert batches contain at most 1000 valid-title rows. Entire Messages custom_id fixup runs for every nonempty updateMessages invocation.

callers.source:

                                                       qApp->settings(),
                                                       messages,
                                                       feed,
                                                       force_update,
                                                       false,
                                                       preserve_existing_read_state)

concrete_sql: SELECT requested.message_index, Messages.id, Messages.date_created, Messages.is_read, Messages.is_important, NULL, Messages.feed, Messages.title, Messages.author FROM (SELECT CAST(:message_index_0 AS SIGNED INTEGER) AS message_index, :lookup_id_0 AS lookup_id) AS requested JOIN Messages ON Messages.id = (  SELECT candidate.id FROM Messages AS candidate WHERE candidate.id = requested.lookup_id LIMIT 1) ORDER BY requested.message_index;

sql_template: SELECT requested.message_index, Messages.id, Messages.date_created, Messages.is_read, Messages.is_important, {contents_column}, Messages.feed, Messages.title, Messages.author FROM ({requested_rows}) AS requested JOIN Messages ON Messages.id = (  SELECT candidate.id FROM Messages AS candidate WHERE candidate.custom_id = requested.custom_id AND {scope_condition} LIMIT 1) ORDER BY requested.message_index;
source_expression:
lookup_query(requested_rows,
                                   QSL("candidate.custom_id = requested.custom_id AND %1").arg(scope_condition))
dynamic_details: See generator_details. force_insert skips lookups; updates reexecute one prepared statement per changed row. Insert batches contain at most 1000 valid-title rows. Entire Messages custom_id fixup runs for every nonempty updateMessages invocation.

callers.source:
DatabaseQueries::updateMessages(qApp->database(),
                                                       qApp->settings(),
                                                       messages,
                                                       feed,
                                                       force_update,
                                                       false,
                                                       preserve_existing_read_state)

generator_details.requested_row_template: SELECT CAST(:message_index_{i} AS SIGNED INTEGER) AS message_index, :custom_id_{i} AS custom_id
generator_details.skip_condition: force_insert or no messages in that lookup class

sql_template: SELECT requested.message_index, Messages.id, Messages.date_created, Messages.is_read, Messages.is_important, {contents_column}, Messages.feed, Messages.title, Messages.author FROM ({requested_rows}) AS requested JOIN Messages ON Messages.id = (  SELECT candidate.id FROM Messages AS candidate WHERE candidate.feed = :feed AND candidate.title = requested.title AND candidate.url = requested.url AND candidate.author = requested.author LIMIT 1) ORDER BY requested.message_index;
source_expression:
lookup_query(requested_rows,
                                   QSL("candidate.feed = :feed AND candidate.title = requested.title AND "
                                       "candidate.url = requested.url AND candidate.author = requested.author"))
dynamic_details: See generator_details. force_insert skips lookups; updates reexecute one prepared statement per changed row. Insert batches contain at most 1000 valid-title rows. Entire Messages custom_id fixup runs for every nonempty updateMessages invocation.
